registration_kind: pre-fit and pre-holdout; frozen before H57 feature build, model fit, or scoring
primary_question: Does a band-semantics-correct geophysical/subsurface View A versus surface/radiometric View B, with confidence-disagreement pseudo-exchange only when spatial out-of-fold proxy errors are not strongly coupled, recover whole held-out mapped fault components better than matched single-view and max-union controls?

training_features.tif.provenance: integrity-pinned owner-maintained mirror of a login-walled competition raster; not organizer-authenticated

labels.tif.provenance: integrity-pinned owner-maintained mirror of a login-walled competition raster; not organizer-authenticated

sample_submission.tif.provenance: integrity-pinned owner-maintained mirror of a login-walled competition raster; not organizer-authenticated; grid and footprint template only

band_identity_and_view_split.band_6: assigned to View B as radiometric total-count-like data because it matches the owner-mirrored GeoDAWN TC grid at Spearman rho approximately 0.99995; the competition TIFF's own tags call it magnetic and conflict with this inference, and no official band-mapping document has been verified

feature_construction.raw_inputs: All listed bands, read without using labels to transform or select features; nodata/sentinel excluded.
feature_construction.View_A_local_features: Gradient-magnitude features on bands 2 (RTP), 13 (isostatic gravity anomaly), 14 (TMI), and 17 (conductivity surface), after normalized-convolution Gaussian smoothing at sigma 1, 3, and 8 pixels (100, 300, 800 m).
feature_construction.View_B_local_features: Gradient-magnitude features on band 6 and band 12 at sigma 1, 3, and 8 pixels; absolute Laplacian-of-Gaussian features on band 12 at the same scales.
feature_construction.input_normalization: No label-based normalization. HistGradientBoosting fits its internal feature bins on each training fold only.

holdout_protocol.spatial_layout: Four contiguous raster quadrants. Original 8-connected catalogue components are assigned whole to their majority eligible quadrant. Evaluation covers the quadrant plus any held-component tails and the metric-support neighborhood.
holdout_protocol.target: All eligible held-out catalogue fault pixels; component and spatial fold never split across train/evaluation.
holdout_protocol.negative_class: Catalogue-zero pixels at least 3 pixels from every known label, used only as proxy negatives; not verified geological absence.
holdout_protocol.label_leakage: No held component, evaluation pixel, or 80-pixel evaluation buffer enters model fitting or pseudo-label training.

learner.sampling: seeded uniform row sampling from the same train/positive/proxy-negative masks for all views and arms
learner.random_state_rule: Both views use the same random_state per outer fold (holdout seed + fold); both full-data views use holdout seed + 100.

co_training_gate.measurement: Spatially out-of-fold, per-view errors aggregated over 50x50-pixel blocks in the held-out catalogue-zero proxy pool.
co_training_gate.interpretation: This is only a proxy diagnostic. Because the public training raster does not supply verified geological absences, low correlation cannot establish conditional independence.

pseudo_label_protocol.cap_component_priority: descending mean teacher score, then first row-major pixel; add whole components while within the cap and skip a component that would exceed the remaining allowance

primary_arm_rule: Use the disagreement-aware co-trained field only if the proxy-error gate passes and both whole-segment exchange directions meet the frozen minimum in all four outer folds and the final full-data refit; otherwise use the predeclared View-B-only field. Do not switch arms based on holdout scores.

field_and_placement.score_scaling: Map each view's model score to a tie-aware empirical CDF rank using only training-domain predictions; no evaluation labels or scores set the reference distribution.
field_and_placement.strata: Confident means rank >= 0.99; abstention means rank in [0.40, 0.80]. A-only is A-confident/B-abstaining; B-only is B-confident/A-abstaining; concordant is both confident.
field_and_placement.metric: Official distance-weighted Tversky: alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular kernel k(d)=max(1-d/300m,0).
field_and_placement.placement: Same literal triangular-kernel marginal expected-coverage greedy for every arm; no truth is passed to placement; fixed 37,654 global-cell budget scaled by each fold's eligible evaluation-region area.
field_and_placement.placement_caveat: Expected max-coverage is a placement surrogate, not expected DTI and not a public-score forecast.
field_and_placement.emitted_values: Binary 1.0 on selected pixels, 0.0 elsewhere inside the template footprint.

promotion_gate.historical_floor_source: evidence/h55_profile_holdout.json structural_contrast_h55 mean; same broad four-quadrant/80-pixel family, but the legacy feature split placed band 6 in A, so it is a conservative reference hurdle, not a matched refit
promotion_gate.failed_gate_artifact_label: RESEARCH ONLY — DO NOT SUBMIT; preserve the weekly slot

submission_format.outside_footprint: NaN/nodata only outside the template validity mask, following the official problem-page wording
